summary: Contact resumed after a fully silent week, and the relationship is calm — but the money is now flowing the wrong way. Stephski chased the July 15–31 invoice on Aug 11; Alex explained she was waiting on money ALTR owes her, which was stuck behind a PayPal hold on ALTR's side. Derrek was responsive all week (same-day on Aug 11, 12 and 13) but the hold only partially cleared: on Aug 13 he said one of two accounts worked, and Alex still had to ask for $2,434 to be netted off her invoice — the second month running that ALTR's debt to her has been settled by shrinking her invoice rather than paying her. She then paid in full the same day ($9,821 AUD), five days past the requested 7-day window. On delivery, she asked on Aug 12 whether ALTR is still using her Instagram; Derrek confirmed posting had been paused until the new phone farm arrived, which leaves Michelle's Jul 28 promise that posting on @paigealexxo would 'start this week' 16 days unmet. DMCA and reel-inspo cadences both landed on time. Her tone stayed warm and accommodating throughout — no anger, but two long-running deliverables are still open.
